questions.title: Two Sum
questions.description: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to target. Each input has exactly one solution. You may not use the same element twice. Return the smaller index first.
questions.hint: Can you remember each number you have already visited? A hash map lets you find its complement in constant time.

questions.title: Contains Duplicate
questions.description: Return true if any value appears at least twice in nums. Return false if every element is distinct.
questions.hint: Compare the number of elements with the number of unique elements.

questions.title: Valid Anagram
questions.description: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. An anagram uses the same letters with the same frequencies in any order.
constraints: Inputs contain only lowercase English letters.
questions.hint: Count how many times each letter appears in both strings.

questions.title: Binary Search
questions.description: Given a sorted array nums in ascending order and an integer target, return the index of target. Return -1 if it does not exist. Aim for O(log n) time.
constraints: All numbers in nums are unique.
questions.hint: Compare the middle value with the target and discard half the search interval.

questions.title: Valid Parentheses
questions.description: Given a string containing only (, ), {, }, [ and ], determine whether it is valid. Open brackets must close in the correct order with the same type of bracket.
constraints: The string contains only bracket characters.
questions.hint: A stack remembers the most recently opened bracket.

questions.title: Maximum Subarray
questions.description: Find the contiguous, nonempty subarray with the largest sum and return its sum.
questions.hint: At each position, decide whether to extend the previous subarray or start a new one.

questions.title: Product of Array Except Self
questions.description: Return an array answer where answer[i] equals the product of every element in nums except nums[i]. Solve without division in O(n) time.
constraints: All prefix and suffix products fit in a 32-bit integer.
questions.hint: Multiply the product of the elements to the left by the product of the elements to the right.

questions.title: Trapping Rain Water
questions.description: Given nonnegative integers representing an elevation map with bars of width 1, return how many units of rainwater it can trap.
questions.hint: Water at each index is limited by the shorter of the highest walls on its left and right.
